title: Dear Human, Poetry Might Save Us from the Apocalypse - Nautilus
gist: Kristen French reflects on "Dear Human at the Edge of Time: A Community Poem," written by 14 U.S. writers, which imagines surviving collapse by learning to move as one like birds. She argues that in the three years since, collective survival has grown more pressing yet society has not learned to act collectively.
